name: Cloudbooklet

sources.title: cloudbooklet.net serves the same 'Free AI Chat' shell as cloudbooklet.com — the .net domain mirrors/redirects to the .com product
Contact page — email + Facebook/Twitter only; no public 'submit a tool' form

requirements: No public submission form exists — cloudbooklet.net (and cloudbooklet.com) is primarily a free AI chat/image/story tool that also runs a large AI tools section (/ai-tools/<slug>)
The only stated contact channel is email (listed on /contact, address is Cloudflare-obfuscated) plus Facebook/Twitter
Existing tool pages have a 'Suggest an update' form, but that edits existing listings — it is not a new-tool intake
preparation: Product name, URL, short description, pricing model, launch date — matching the fields shown on their existing /ai-tools/ pages
A pitch email explaining why the tool fits their AI directory
workflow: Email the listed address (or message via Facebook/Twitter) requesting a new AI-tool listing with product details
If the product is already listed, use the 'Suggest an update' box on its tool page instead
watchFor: The batch listed cloudbooklet.net, but the real product/domain is cloudbooklet.com — .net serves the same shell; submit against .com
No documented intake: listings may be editorially sourced rather than community-submitted
Site is ad/affiliate-heavy (e.g. 'recommended' links to partner tools) — expect slow or no response
countsAsLive: The product has a dedicated page under cloudbooklet.com/ai-tools/<slug> with description, pricing, and launch-date fields
unknowns: Whether they accept unsolicited submissions at all — no form or policy page found
Whether listing is free or paid/sponsored
